batting.name: CH Gayle
batting.dismissal: c RJ Harris b PP Chawla

batting.name: TM Dilshan
batting.dismissal: c P Kumar b R McLaren

batting.name: PC Valthaty
batting.dismissal: c A Mithun b CH Gayle

batting.name: AM Nayar
batting.dismissal: c SS Tiwary b S Aravind

batting.name: Sunny Singh
batting.dismissal: c AUK Pathan b DL Vettori

batting.name: RJ Harris
batting.dismissal: c AUK Pathan b S Aravind

balls.text: ends with another one in the blockhole, it is squeezed away to long off, good comeback from Harris
angles this one in on a length, he swivels for the pull, but it hurries on, and he gets it away towards short fine leg
high full toss, swiped away towards covers
one more yorker, and it goes for four, well, no justice for the ones hurling it in, inside edge that runs away to the fine leg boundary, 200 up for Bangalore
got 'em! Harris continues to get the wickets, another yorker, off the boot on to the leg stump
well bowled, 139.8 kph yorker, he manages to get his legs out of the way, and digs it out, they scamper the single as Harris rushes for the ball
will keep the strike with a single on the off side
as effortless as it gets, AB uses the angle in to him to get maximum, stays back, lets the fuller one comes on, and swings it over deep midwicket, back leg turns in rhythm as well
another drop, this time it is Dinesh, Kaif went for another pull, this one was not short enough, he got a top edge that went steepling up towards midwicket, Dinesh had it covered and clanged it
gets on top of this short delivery, Kaif, and pulls it wide of deep midwicket, who dives to his left to save the boundary
swing-and-a-miss as he tries to make room and slog a short one
goes for a pull from outside leg stump, misses and takes it on the body
two in two, Gilly finds some reason to smile. swings in, pitches full and continues inward to strike him on the pad, umpire Dar thinks he is a goner, and he is gone
Tiwary goes this time, backs away for a slog, and ends up top-edging a short ball that Harris takes easily
belts the cover drive off the middle of the bat, but will get only a single as there is sweeper cover in place, will that go down in history as the fastest drive to reach the man on the boundary?
length ball and AB takes toll, slamming it over the bowler's head and in to the straight boundary
AB goes for the old-fashioned hoick from the crease, and gets a top edge that flies over Gilchrist, when nothing goes your away, abandon all hope
Tiwary goes for a forcing pull to a ball that is not quite short, and picks up a single to deep midwicket
Tiwary with the muscular version of the slog sweep, mistimes it down to deep square leg
comes down the track and flicks through midwicket for a single
now AB decides to have a go, no fuss at all, goes down on one knee, and slogs a flat delivery in to a sea of red over deep midwicket
charges down the track, looking for the big swing, mistimes it past extra cover towards long off, looked like the wrong 'un
pitched up fuller, Tiwary waits for it, and swings it over cow corner
pushed down the track off the front foot
slower one, he guides it towards point off the front foot
walks down the track, and pushes this one away past cover
down the pads, screaming "hit me", Tiwary flicks it past short fine leg, that'll do
comes down the track and pushes away towards extra cover
goes back, drops a length ball in front of point for another quick run
this seems other-worldly now, a busy single after a soft-handed push in front of extra cover

gone! Piyush gets another one, too full and close for the cut, but Virat went for it, the ball hurried on, and clattered in to the stumps, Virat went flat down on his back on the ground as if to ram home the point that the ball kept low, the lad gets an A for theatrics, Piyush points towards the dressing room for effect
wristily whips this one from around off stump to long on

it's finally over, the nightmare is finally over for Punjab, Bangalore gives a standing ovation to Chris Gayle as he walks off after pulling a short one straight to deep midwicket, the storm has blown over, Punjab have been left wrecked

now there;'s a drop as well, it's all hapening, Gayle slogs it over square leg, fielder had his eyes on the ball as it came down from stratosphere, got both hands to it, it popped out, made another attempt, it popped out again, and for good measure, rolled in to the boundary
careful back foot defence from Gayle, never a dull moment you know
flatter one angling in, he goes back and whips it through midwicket

second IPL hundred for Chris Gayle, low full toss eased down to long off, Gayle jumps in the air, the smile cannot get broader, helmet comes off, high fives from Virat, the smiles manages to get even broader, Bangalore has gone wild
gets to 99 with a couple, high full toss on leg stump, Gayle turns it straight to short fine leg, who lets it slip through
gets on top of a short one and pulls it wide of deep midwicket, but Gayle wants the century fast, he has taken only a single
shortish and wide, Virat goes hard at it from the crease and is beaten
mistimes a forcing swipe in to the leg side for a single

moves to 96 now with a straight six over the sightscreen, just gets front leg out of the way and the monster swing does the rest, don't bowl length, don't bowl full, don't bowl short, rather stop bowling, go on strike, that;s the trend anyways these days
moves to 90 with a mistimed heave to long on
and another one, I have lost count, half-tracker, Gayle rocks back and sends it miles in to the crowd over deep midwicket
shortish and sitting up outside off, Virat throws his bat at it, but extra cover takes some pace off the ball as he gets a hand to it
Nayar drops it marginally short, and Gayle pings deep midwicket with a furious pull
charges out and has a huge heave but misses this one
stays in the crease and pushes a length ball on the off side
cut fiercely off the back foot, but straight to point
pushed back to the bowler off the front foot
looks to pulls this one that goes on with the angle, misses
Virat continues to stamp his class amid the mayhem, gets inside the line of a flighted one, and whip-drives it past extra cover, long off has no chance, it was timed so well
cut away to point off the back foot
even an outside edge gets him four, it is pouring boundaries, Gayle pushes at one going across and it is too far from Gilly's dive
no one needs to take blame for this one apart from the bowler, low full toss on the stumps, Gayle makes enough room to swing the arms and belts it straight past the non-striker
full toss, Gayle hammers it, it is hit so hard that it bursts throgh extra cover's hands. bowler thinks it is fielder's fault for letting it go, fielder thinks why did he have to get in the way
slower one, he allows it to come on and pushes for a single towards covers
well played, Virat goes outside leg stump, and picks a length ball over extra cover, authoritative stroke
short, wide but does not disappear, Virat goes hard at it and gets it towards deep point for a couple
a touch short and angled in, he goes back ti turn it backward of square leg
bowled slowly through the air, turns away and Virat guides it toward short third man
tucked away in front of square for a single
for once, he is beaten as Piyush slants one wide across him
Piyush tries the flatter one, so Gayle goes flat as well, rocks back and pulls it for a flat six, brings up the 100 as well
this is painful to watch, the bowler might as well be replaced by a machine, everything is disappeared, Piyush does not help by bowling a short one and Gayle kills it over midwicket

if that had been middled, either it would have taken Ablish to the straight boundary with it, or the ball would have cracked in to two, fortunately the big man does not time it, and gets a single towards long on
Gayle has no love lost for Ablish, gets underneath a slower one, and lifts it high over wide long on, there is no getting away from him
tucked away off the pads through square leg
bowls this one straighter and still fuller, he pats it back to the bowler
lovely use of the angle, Virat gets one coming in from wide of the crease, and wrists it over mdiwicket, just sent the ball in its way with a quick twirl
gets some bounce on this back of a length ball outside off stump, he comes forward and pushes it away to point
50 off 28 balls for the big man, the crowd loves it, Gayle stands tall and belts a length ball wide of extra cover, long off dives but it trickles in to the boundary
Virat shuffles and plays one of those whippy flicks in front of square leg for a single
works this one through square leg, he wanted a second, there was only one
no violence this time, but Punjab are bleeding nevertheless, Gayle tucks one on the pads happily past short fine leg
now he stays back to a length ball, gets back leg towards the leg side, and pulls it mercilessly, gets lot of height on it, and just gets it over the wide long on boundary
smoked! Gayle stands motionless, but as the length ball approaches him, he breaks in to a flurry of action, and creams PK over the Chinnaswamy roof
Gayle goes back and gets a length ball towards midwicket to keep the strike
now he works him for a single in front of square leg

well, well, that is what you get after having a wicket denied, you are smashed for a boundary straight down the ground, Virat takes a step out to a full ball and bashes it between bowler and mid off, justice denied and then rubbed in

Virat is gone, or so it seems, went for a forcing pull to a back of a length ball that bounced extra and took a healthy edge on its way to Gilly, even as Punjab are celebrating, umpire Tiffin wonders what the fuss is about, he didn't think that was an edge, if there wasn't, I am Mohammad Ali
Virat is playing very carefully, watches a length ball right to the end and watchfully pushes it away to cover
the angle is over-cooked on this one, makes it go wide down leg
angles a length ball in from very wide of the crease, bounces extra and makes Virat go back to push it back to ryan
patted back to the bowler off the back foot

how did that miss the stumps? Virat had almost committed harakiri, plonking one in front of extra cover and calling Gayle for the run, he was nowhere to be seen when McLaren dived and lobbed the ball at the non-striker's stumps, it seemed to be heading for timber but swerved just a bit in the end, missing by millimetres, or any smaller unit you can think of
the swing comes back, bowled fuller with more zip from the wrist, and it moves further away outside off as Virat has a go at it and misses
tight stuff from PK now, not much movement but on a straight line around off stump, Virat plays it out on the leg side
keeps a touch low as it comes in with the angle on off, Virat does a SAchin as he crouches down after keeping it out
length ball outside off stump, left alone
wickets make no difference to Gayle, he gets a fuller one angled across him, and goes hard at it in cavalier fashion, slicing it high and one bounce in to the deep point boundary

Dilshan departs, he tried to pick a length ball over midwicket, is not in control of the shot as bat turns in the hands, the ball goes a mile to get a view of the Bangalore skyline and comes down to find PK waiting, he takes it calmly
hits this one in to the covers for a single
good ball from McLaren, the yorker outside leg stump as he sees Gayle backing away, dug out back to the bowler
swatted away! length ball outside off stump, Gayle stands in the crease and whips it past mid on, that's as close as he is getting to VVS Laxman
Gayle tries to welcome McLaren with a big swing, but misses the ball going across him
creamed, absolutely creamed off the front foot, but straight to extra cover
beautiful drive, why does he bother with those forcing shots when he can do this, pitched up and he hangs the bat out, ball hits middle and disappears in the gap between cover and point

Dilshan is not getting left behind, he wants some of the action too,. gets a short ball and swivels furiously for the pull, Punjab persist to having no one in the region of deep square leg, dilshan get four
the two sixes seem to have rattled Punjab, Gayle picks up  a single off a misfield around square leg
bigger, this time he walks across the stumps, stands with legs spread apart, and mows a length ball over wide long on

clobber! finally, after eons, Gayle gets one in his slot, full, around off stump, Gayle gets front leg out of the way, and hammers it over long off, there is a man there, he is just closer to the action, can't do anything else
reverts to the line outside off stump, Dilshan sticks to swat-driving, more bounce again, and Dilshan is beaten

there is no one at deep square leg, there is no one at fine leg, Dilshan gets a length ball on leg stump, and is happy to flick it away in a flash, the man from deep midwicket runs in a mile and puts in the dive, in vain as he touches the rope
no matter what  the track is doing, Dilshan knows no lower gear, he stands in the crease and tries to play his swat-drive, gets an inside edge as this one bounces high
Gayle manages to get away from all the intense examination, tucking one off his pads to midwicket
more movement, Gayle is beaten outside off stump as another one goes across him
PK continues to get the ball to move away appreciably, but this one is some way outside off stump, and for once Gayle is happy to leave it alone
can't put bat to ball, but there are other ways to get runs, like getting the ball off your pads behind square leg
Gayle persists with the attempts at tonking the ball  out of sight, only issue is, he can't connect at the moment as he rushes down the track again
there is lots of lateral movement on this pitch, again Gayle is beaten by one that pitches around middle and leg, and zooms away from Gayle, leaving him looking befuddled
and again, this time he backed away outside leg and came down the track as well, missed with the big swing, and the ball went over the stumps
Gayle abandons niceties like defence and charges down the track, Harris angles this one away, and Gayle is beaten, swinging inside the line
now Harris gets one to zip away sharply, pitches back of a length outside leg and rushes across Gayle outside off, he pulled back his bat a bit in the end
more width, and short in length too, Dilshan likes it, stands in the crease, and cuts hard over point, thank you very much
gives him some width outside off stump, Dilshan goes hard at it and punches without timing to mid off
bangs this one short of a length on leg and gets it to straighten, Gayle rides the bounce, plonks it down and picks up a single
this is more like Gayle, after two went away, this one came in, Gayle had already made up his mind, came down the track, and clobbered it over midwicket
a bit further up this time, same result, this one moves away in the air, and then continues on that path, Gayle manages another feeble push
ripper, pitches leg, and then decides to zip across Gayle from a length, he pushes and is beaten
big swing, and miss from PK outside off stump and that is the end of that
PK is letting Mithun have it, this time clobbers him over deep midwicket for maximum
fuller this time, PK targets the same area for another boundary, and gets it, bt this time off an outside edge past the keeper
PK gets one away, gets underneath a length ball and hammers it over mid off
high full toss, PK is surprised and fends it back to the bowler, and tells Mithun to go back and bowl, Mithun gives gives him a stare, Gayle can't control his glee, he loves it
another short one, he looks to have another go, but pulls out of the shot in the end
dug in short, he goes for a big heave, and misses
hit away to sweeper cover, end of Aravind's spell, and these are his best figures in T20s
back of a length, calmly played out to point
it's almost over now, another wicket, goes for this slow, full and wide one outside off, ending up slicing it to short third man, now Aravind and Gayle are smiling widely together
goes deep in the crease to work it in front of midwicket
Aravind gets one more, it was the slower one, he went for a mow through midwicket from the crease, and edged it on to the stumps
on a length outside off stump, he calmly shoulders arms
bashes a full one back at the bowler, Mithun goes down to stop it
squeezed out to point, there is an overthrow from Dilshan and cross over
in the blockhole, dug out for a single
short ball banged in, he goes for the pull from way outside off and misses, Mithun is excited, no one else is as there is non edge
low full toss squeezed in front of point, virat fires in the throw making the batsman dive in
full delivery dug back to the bowler
goes across and whips a full one in air to fine leg
very full, squeezed away down to long off for another single
pushed away to point, overbalances and stumbles before sending the non-striker back
opens the face and guides it with soft hands in front of point
goes for the lofted drive from the crease, thick edge flies to third man
turned past Gayle at midwicket for a single
virat almost gets a wicket, slips one in between bat and pad, ball misses the stumps, keeper misses the ball, all even
guided to point off the back foot
driven off the front foot to long on
low full toss turned to deep square leg
slower wobbly full one, he slices it over the man at cover, sweeper cover tidies up
clipped off the pads to Vettori at short fine leg
trundles in and bowls a very high full toss, he is surprised as he turns it away through square leg
very full and bowled slowly, squeezed away to point
short ball sits up and is pulled way over midwicket for four
turned off the pads towards midwicket where Gayle misfields
against all those sleepy singles and woeful wickets, McLaren shuffles across, and clips emphatically through midwicket
wants to turn this one towards mid on but pushes it back to Zaheer
guided to point off the back foot, goes to him on the bounce
slanted wide down leg with the angle from over the wicket
worked away to deep backward square leg and Vettori is done for the day
driven down the ground for a single
turned to short fine leg for a run
played out towards midwicket
direct hit at the non-striker's but he was just in, umpire did not even refer it upstairs, some call that
punched away on the off side
Gayle's spell ends with a tuck behind square leg, has to be content with three wickets, should do along with that century for the night
tossed up slowly through the air, comes down and pushes it back to the bowler
shortish and cut away to sweeper cover off the back foot
jabs away a very full delivery towards point
tucked away off the back foot to short fine leg
tossed up around off stump, driven to extra cover
whipped away to deep square leg for another single
slower through the air, edged just past Gayle at slip
pushed away in to the leg side off the front foot
the one that slides on straight with the angle, hit on the pads, going down leg
defended off the front foot on the off side
goes deep to work it away to deep square leg
Gayle continues to do different versions of his celebratory jig, saw Piyush come down the track, fired it in, and the batsman yorked himself
driven towards long off for another run
cut away to sweeper cover for a single
low full toss, Gayle had tonked them out of sight, this one goes along the ground to long on
slashed away to short third man off the back foot
flighted around off stump, pushed away in front of cover for a single, throw comes in to AB, referred to the third umpire, he is in comfortably
punched off the back foot to long on, this seems like the middle overs of an ODI
guided from the crease to Zaheer at short third man
works it off the back foot in front of square leg, they deliberate whether to go for the second, decide against it
fires this one in flat and quick, beaten on the cut
works away a shortish one backward of square leg
pushes a flighted one off the front foot and they go for the quick single
banged in short, he looks to turn it fine but gets a top edge that goes over the keeper
Gayle has another one, goes down for the sweep, full delivery hits him on the half volley, that is straight, that is dead, that is gone, and Gayle's smile just gets broader and broader
pushed away in to the off side
bends the knee and swings this one backward of square leg
punched off the back foot to sweeper cover
shuffles and turns this one in to the vacant midwicket area, and they come back for the second
flighted one tucked backward of square leg, Gayle comes in from short fine to field
bowled slowly and turning away, he opens the face to run it to short third man

I had to say that, didn't I? next ball Sunny abandons his crease, he is not close to the pitch and still has a go, Pathan settles under it close to the rope at long on and takes a high well-judged catch
goes back and works this one past midwicket, Punjab dawdling along, at least they are not losing wickets
this one hurries on with the arm, he goes on the back foot and jabs it away
pushed away in to the off side
short of a good length and turned to midwicket, dinesh had rushed out for the single, and had to dive back in
comes forward to drive a length ball that is cut off by sweeper cover
tucked off the pads backward of square for a single
goes for the back foot punch but edges it in to the ground
shortish this time, dinesh walks out and pulls through midwicket
well played, angled in to the pads, and he flicks it in the air to the deep square leg boundary, crowd goes dead silent
forcing push past the bowler, it gathers  momentum as it runs along the ground, Vettori lumbers after it but there is another man around to stop it
pushes out with high elbow and picks a single to deepish mid off
flicked away to square leg where Tiwary moves to his right to field
and another one goes! Punjab will want to forget this evening quickly, another leading edge, looked to work a length ball on the leg side, plays it early, Aravind accepts the dolly
goes for a pull off the front foot from outside off stump but cannot beat square leg
shuffles to turn a length ball towards midwicket for a single
shuffles and works a length ball towards midwicket
low full toss and he gets it away, going down for the reverse sweep and getting it past short third man
pats this fuller one down the track

gone! it's Gayle night at the Chinnaswamy, flighted outside leg stump, and he gets a wicket, he looked to turn it but closed the face early, getting an edge that looped tamely to square leg, Gayle does a neat jig as he celebrates
shortish and angled in, pulled away to square leg who fumbles to concede the run
tosses it up from round the stumps, pushed away off the front foot
Valthaty does not bother with things such as foot work, and this time it works for him, swings forcefully at a length ball going across and lofts it high over wide mid off
pushed away off the front foot towards mid on
was that an edge, there was some excitement from the bowler, but anyways it fell short of AB as he went for a slog on the leg side
backs away outside leg, he bowls it across the batsman who has a swing, and a miss
clobber goes Valthaty, hits hard from the crease but straight to mid off
solidly forward in defence comes March, gets a bit of an inside edge on the leg side
finishes the over with another boundary, just stands tall, and punches a length ball on the up, it bounces extra to go uppishly, but in the gap between cover and mid off
another short ball, he goes hard on the pull, does not time it well, but does enough to take it past the vacant midwicket region and in to the boundary
Valthaty goes on a leg, goes deep in the crease and pulls a short one in front of square leg for a boundary
played with soft hands from the crease and even as it moves away to take a thick edge, it rolls along the ground past backward point
well left, close to off stump from over the stumps and Marsh lets it go
length ball pushed away to mid off
short and wide outside off stump, he reaches out but it is too far from him
that will be the end of Nayar, wonder what they were thinking sending him at No 3, shuffled across and flicked a full one off the pads straight to Tiwary at square leg
leaves Nayar groping outside off stump with one that zips away
punched towards covers, another direct hit at the non-striker;s, Valthaty was back just in time before middle stump flew out of the ground
mistimes the forcing pull and gets a single wide of mid on
cramped for room by the one that nips back in, he is looking very uncomfortable out there
goes hard at one angled across him from the crease, and is beaten
pegged on the back foot by one that cuts back in from short of a length, gets it in front of midwicket and they take him on for a quick run
punches off the back foot, and it goes to point on the bounce
shuffles across the stumps and flicks a length ball to fine leg
mid off is a bit deep, and that allows them to get the single off a backfoot punch
135.9 kph and slides this one down the leg side off a length, some inward shape on it
stands in the crease and goes hard at a short and wide one, is beaten, and Zaheer lets him know with a colourful mouthful

gone first ball! boy, what a break for Bangalore, Gilly pushed a straight ball past Zaheer, and rushed down for the single, mid on got to the ball and fired in the throw, Gilly was still lumbering in when he was found short by the direct hit
